caption: Huis Van Gijn, Dordrecht
composition: Louis XIV canal house with a straight cornice on Nieuwe Haven · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Huis Van Gijn fronts Nieuwe Haven, beside Wolwevershaven: a wide 1729 house with a straight cornice, a hipped roof, five window bays, and an ornate doorway with a stoop. Dark water fills the foreground. The sky is mainly clear, about 16.5°C, with wind near 8.6 km/h, and a bright moon is up. The Grote Kerk is outside this frame. The museum is closed.
